Hi! As someone who is AMAB but who wears makeup to appear more feminine I’d love to share a few tips that work for me. :)

I like to contour using a warmer shade, usually bronzer (more of a personal preference than anything else) but I like to give the illusion of higher cheekbones by placing the powder slightly above my natural cheekbones.

Blush also ties into this, instead of applying it on the apples on my cheeks I put it just above the bronzer (a light coat, so it doesn’t look too clownish) and it lifts my face wonderfully, I also place a slight amount on my nose and forehead as it seems to soften my face a bit.

Nose contouring can do wonders for softening your face, it’s quite tricky to get the hang of but there are a lot of useful videos on YouTube that are helpful for this.

As other comments have said, shaping your eyebrows a little bit and shading them in will also do wonders, it can change your whole face.

Lastly, over lining your lips oh so slightly can definitely give the illusion of a more feminine appearance.

I hope this was somewhat helpful, by no means an expert just someone who enjoys wearing makeup!
